# inertance.org

Public site for **Inertance** — an interactive simulator that shows switching power
conversion as a hydraulic circuit.

- `index.html` — landing page
- `lab/index.html` — the buck converter demo, **generated, do not edit by hand**
- `app/index.html` — the working circuit simulator in the Compact hybrid layout,
  **generated by `build_app.py` from `app-src/`, do not edit by hand**
- `app-src/` — app shell markup, styles, host glue and assets
- `tools/check-app.cjs` — headless browser check of the built app
- `update_from_simulator.py` — simulator → site pipeline (builds and checks both repos)
- `docs/APP.md`, `docs/DEPLOYMENT.md` — app architecture and release record
- `build.py` — regenerates `lab/index.html` from the private simulator source
- `CNAME` — custom domain for GitHub Pages

## Published site

Open [inertance.org](https://inertance.org/) or go directly to the
[working simulator](https://inertance.org/app/). GitHub Pages publishes `main`
from the repository root, with HTTPS enforced.

## Rebuilding the demo

The simulator source lives in the private `hydraulic-circuit-lab` repo, expected as a
sibling directory:

```
dev/
  cwas/                 ← private source (hydraulic-circuit-lab)
  inertance-site/       ← this repo
```

For a release, commit the simulator sources in the private repo first, then run:

```sh
python3 update_from_simulator.py --release
```

Review and commit the generated `app/` and `lab/` together with relevant site
sources, then push `main`. Pushing publishes the site. The build records the
private simulator revision in the app Help menu.

Rebuild the simulator app after changing `app-src/`:

```sh
python3 build_app.py
node tools/check-app.cjs
```

After changing the simulator itself, run everything (both repos, all checks):

```sh
python3 update_from_simulator.py            # --quick, --release, --full, --skip-lab
```

Workflow and change-type guide: `../cwas/docs/WEBSITE-WORKFLOW.md` (private repo).

`build.py` wraps `circuit-lab.fragment.html` in a standalone document, supplies the
design tokens and utility classes the fragment expects from its authoring harness, and
restricts the topology picker to the buck converter.

## Note

This repo is public and contains the generated client apps and their website shell
and build tools. Private development notes, research and roadmap stay in cwas.
Simulator JavaScript is intentionally inlined in the public apps.
